subject: Field Trip Permission Slip Due Friday
body:
Dear families,

Our class field trip to the Science Museum is coming up. Please sign and return the attached permission slip by Friday 3pm. The trip fee is $12 per student.

Thank you,
Lincoln Elementary Office
